temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. In conversation, Gary appreciates Ethan's concern but refuses the weekend retreat because of too much hospital work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan is concerned that Gary is overworking and damaging his health, but may not yet know the underlying reasons.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary confirms heavy hospital obligations and reluctance to take a break, strengthening Ethan's concern that Gary is overcommitted and resistant to rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is seriously overworked by professional responsibilities and currently unwilling or unable to step away for rest.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary reduce overwork and rest, possibly by continuing to encourage him or finding another way to intervene.

temporal_state_chain.observed: At the retreat, Ethan sees Gary acting restless and avoiding discussion of work. When confronted, Gary admits it is complicated and says he did not want to burden Ethan.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary is overworked by hospital obligations and needs rest.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's restlessness, avoidance, and admission that things are complicated lead Ethan to suspect there is more than professional overwork, and that Gary has been withholding personal problems to avoid burdening him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is dealing with a complicated, likely deeper or personal issue behind his overwork, and he needs nonjudgmental support to open up.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gently confront Gary, reassure him that he can share anything, and encourage him to open up without judgment.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and the personal challenges he is facing. He agrees to Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and get help organizing his schedule.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has a complicated deeper problem behind his overwork and has been reluctant to burden others.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Ethan now understands the specific sources of Gary's stress: new-department pressures plus personal challenges. He also learns Gary is willing to accept practical help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary's overwork is driven by new department responsibilities and personal challenges; with prioritization, delegation, and schedule organization, he can work toward better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary find a better balance by organizing his schedule, prioritizing tasks, and delegating responsibilities.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan regularly checks in. Gary reports that things are better, he is not as overwhelmed, and he had time for a movie last weekend.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary's overwork stems from department and personal pressures, and that Gary has agreed to work on balance with Ethan's help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's reports and actions show genuine effort and progress, reducing Ethan's worry.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making real progress toward healthier balance and is less overwhelmed, though challenges may remain; ongoing encouragement is helpful.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To continue checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees that Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and feels more in control. Gary thanks Ethan for his support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believes Gary has been making progress with support but may still face challenges.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes. Gary's sustained adjustment and sense of control convince Ethan that Gary can now manage independently.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary has achieved a healthier balance and is capable of maintaining it on his own; Ethan remains available if needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back and let Gary manage independently, while letting Gary know he is always available if needed.
